summary: Tuesday extended a defensive rotation: consumer staples sharply outpaced tech, long Treasuries kept rallying, and gold's momentum faded despite still-elevated hedging costs. Bitcoin outran ether and volatility spiked, yet crypto sentiment held in greed as prices stayed well above their 200-day trend.
tweet: Tuesday's tape stayed defensive — staples over tech, bonds bid, gold losing steam — while crypto wobbled but held its greed footing.
